hardware: AWS m7g.4xlarge (Graviton3, 16 cores / 64 GB). Gateway-under-test pinned to 4 cores (the comparable basis); mock and load generator on 6 cores each so the mock never bottlenecks the streaming sweep. Ubuntu 24.04. One dedicated box per gateway.

bedrock.reason: APISIX 3.17.0 ai-proxy has no native Gemini generateContent or Cohere provider, and no OpenAI-to-Anthropic/Bedrock converter; its one anthropic->openai converter is not offered either, because ai-proxy binds one provider per route URI and the single /v1/messages URI is bound to the anthropic provider (the anthropic>anthropic diagonal) - serving both would need a per-column config rewrite, which the one-static-config standard forbids. Other cells are grey by that capability limit (ai-proxy/base.lua, ai-protocols/converters/init.lua)
